examples.title: Primary action
examples.description: Main command in a compact product flow.
examples.behavior: Use one primary button per decision area.
examples.qa: Label is action-oriented and does not wrap awkwardly.

examples.title: Secondary command
examples.description: Secondary and quiet actions placed beside the primary action.
examples.behavior: Lower emphasis actions remain available without competing with the primary command.
examples.qa: Shortcut text is readable but visually quieter than the label.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: Command is in progress after activation.
examples.behavior: Prevent duplicate submission while preserving button width.
examples.qa: Loading text does not cause layout shift.

examples.title: Destructive
examples.description: Danger action for irreversible or high-impact changes.
examples.behavior: Use only after the surrounding copy makes consequence clear.
examples.qa: Danger foreground token remains readable in every catalog.

default.qa: Primary and secondary hierarchy is clear.

hover.qa: Hover does not move adjacent controls.

destructive.trigger: Action can delete, stop or revoke
destructive.qa: Consequence is explicit in surrounding copy.
